question: How many support cases have severity 1?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_severity_1 FROM sois.public.case AS c WHERE c.severity = 1;

question: How many support cases have severity 1?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM sois.public.case WHERE severity = 1;

question: How many dispatches were there per product family?
sql: SELECT p.family AS product_family, COUNT(d.dispatch_id) AS dispatch_count FROM sois.public.product AS p LEFT JOIN sois.public.dispatch AS d ON 1 = 0 GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY p.family;

question: How many dispatches were there per product family?
sql: SELECT p.family, COUNT(DISTINCT d.dispatch_id) AS dispatch_count FROM sois.public.dispatch d JOIN sois.public.dispatch_part dp ON d.dispatch_id = dp.dispatch_id JOIN sois.public.order_line ol ON dp.part_id = ol.product_id JOIN sois.public.product p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY dispatch_count DESC;

question: For each Product family, count the Dispatch records whose Case is about an Installed Asset of that Product (dispatch -> case -> installed asset -> product).
sql: SELECT p.family, COUNT(d.dispatch_id) AS dispatch_count FROM sois.public.dispatch d INNER JOIN sois.public.case c ON d.case_id = c.case_id INNER JOIN sois.public.installed_asset a ON c.asset_id = a.asset_id INNER JOIN sois.public.product p ON a.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.family;

question: What is the repeat-dispatch rate by product family?
sql: WITH fam AS (SELECT p.family AS product_family FROM sois.public.product p) SELECT f.product_family, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.dispatch_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.visit_number > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(d.dispatch_id) END AS repeat_dispatch_rate FROM fam f LEFT JOIN sois.public.dispatch d ON 1 = 0 GROUP BY f.product_family;

question: What is the repeat-dispatch rate by product family?
sql: SELECT NULL::character varying AS product_family, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN visit_number > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) END AS repeat_dispatch_rate FROM sois.public.dispatch;

question: For each Product family, what fraction of Dispatch records (dispatch -> case -> installed asset -> product) are repeat dispatches, i.e. have visit_number greater than 1?
sql: SELECT p.family, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.visit_number > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS repeat_dispatch_fraction FROM sois.public.dispatch d JOIN sois.public.case c ON d.case_id = c.case_id JOIN sois.public.installed_asset ia ON c.asset_id = ia.asset_id JOIN sois.public.product p ON ia.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY p.family;

question: How many cases were opened last month?
sql: SELECT COUNT(c.case_id) AS cases_opened_last_month FROM sois.public.case AS c WHERE (CASE WHEN c.opened_at LIKE '%/%' THEN to_timestamp(c.opened_at, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') ELSE to_timestamp(c.opened_at, 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SS') END) >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month' AND (CASE WHEN c.opened_at LIKE '%/%' THEN to_timestamp(c.opened_at, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') ELSE to_timestamp(c.opened_at, 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SS') END) < date_trunc('month', current_date);

question: How many cases were opened last month?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cases_opened_last_month FROM sois.public.case c WHERE (CASE WHEN c.opened_at LIKE '__/__/____%' THEN CAST(to_timestamp(c.opened_at, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') AS timestamp) ELSE CAST(c.opened_at AS timestamp) END) >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND (CASE WHEN c.opened_at LIKE '__/__/____%' THEN CAST(to_timestamp(c.opened_at, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') AS timestamp) ELSE CAST(c.opened_at AS timestamp) END) < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE);

question: How many Case records have an opened_at timestamp in June 2026 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30), parsing both the ISO and the MM/DD/YYYY formats?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sois.public.case WHERE (CASE WHEN opened_at LIKE '__/__/____%' THEN to_timestamp(opened_at, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') ELSE CAST(opened_at AS timestamp) END) >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND (CASE WHEN opened_at LIKE '__/__/____%' THEN to_timestamp(opened_at, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') ELSE CAST(opened_at AS timestamp) END) < DATE '2026-07-01';

question: How many cases are there in each case category?
sql: SELECT c.category, COUNT(c.case_id) AS case_count FROM sois.public.case AS c GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY case_count DESC;

question: How many cases were opened against assets in each site region?
sql: SELECT s.region, COUNT(c.case_id) AS case_count FROM sois.public.case AS c JOIN sois.public.installed_asset AS ia ON c.asset_id = ia.asset_id JOIN sois.public.site AS s ON ia.site_id = s.site_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY case_count DESC;

question: How many installed assets are there per product family?
sql: SELECT p.family, COUNT(*) AS installed_asset_count FROM sois.public.installed_asset AS ia JOIN sois.public.product AS p ON ia.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY p.family;

question: How many deflectable cases were opened last quarter?
sql: WITH parsed AS (SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN c.opened_at LIKE '__/__/____%' THEN to_timestamp(c.opened_at, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI')::timestamp ELSE c.opened_at::timestamp END AS opened_ts FROM sois.public.case c) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parsed p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sois.public.runbook r WHERE r.category = p.category) AND ((p.category IN ('how_to', 'config', 'firmware') AND p.severity >= 3) OR p.category = 'false_alarm') AND p.opened_ts >= date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - interval '3 months' AND p.opened_ts < date_trunc('quarter', current_date);

question: How many risky pods are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS risky_pod_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t.datacenter, t.vault_id, t.pod_id FROM sois.public.fleet_risk_top100 f JOIN sois.public.telemetry_drive_summary t ON f.serial_number = t.serial_number WHERE f.heuristic_flag = 1) sub;

question: How many installed assets are in warranty, out of warranty, and of unknown warranty status?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN warranty_end IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN warranty_end >= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'in_warranty' ELSE 'out_of_warranty' END AS warranty_status, COUNT(*) AS asset_count FROM sois.public.installed_asset GROUP BY CASE WHEN warranty_end IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN warranty_end >= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'in_warranty' ELSE 'out_of_warranty' END ORDER BY warranty_status;
